audit.whatIsWrong: The page reduced the matchup to 'the root sets up her whole burst' and never used a real cooldown, never mentioned that Miasma grounds Pop Blossom, never mentioned that Tangle-Barbs upgrades itself, and never mentioned that an immobilizing stun breaks Inherent Glamour.
audit.why: Pop Blossom (R) carries the dash flag — the leap is a movement ability, so Miasma's grounding denies it (confirmed by _missing). Tangle-Barbs (E) becomes larger, faster and roots for longer if it kills a unit or passes through a champion, so standing in line behind your own caster minion hands her the upgraded root. Inherent Glamour (P) breaks on receiving immobilizing crowd control, and Petrifying Gaze (R) stuns anyone facing Cassiopeia — which a Pop Blossom landing satisfies. Real cooldowns: Q 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s, W 16/15/14/13/12s at 0 mana, E 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s, R 120/105/90s.
